## Goal

The REST client for every route of `docs/api.md`, and token storage.

## Plan

### Files to touch

- `frontend/src/api/client.ts`, `frontend/src/api/client.test.ts`
- `frontend/src/auth/token.ts`, `frontend/src/auth/token.test.ts`

### Steps

1. `client.ts`: `export class ApiError extends Error { constructor(public status: number, public code: ErrorCode | "network", message: string) }` (set `name = "ApiError"`).
2. A private `request<T>(method, path, body?)`: `fetch("/api" + path, {method, headers, body: JSON.stringify(body)})` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when `getToken()` is non-null and `Content-Type: application/json` when there is a body. A thrown `fetch` -> `ApiError(0, "network", "Cannot reach the server")`. 204 -> `undefined`. 2xx -> `await res.json()`, where a throw (bad JSON, a dropped connection) is also the network error. Non-2xx: parse JSON; if it has `error.code` and `error.message` strings -> `ApiError(res.status, code, message)`; otherwise `ApiError(res.status, "internal", "Something went wrong")`.
3. `export function createApi(getToken: () => string | null)` returning `{register(username, displayName, password), login(username, password), logout(), me(), listBoards(), createBoard(name), getBoard(id), renameBoard(id, name), addMember(boardId, username), createColumn(boardId, name), renameColumn(id, name), deleteColumn(id), createCard(columnId, title, description?), updateCard(id, patch: CardPatch), moveCard(id, columnId, position), deleteCard(id)}` typed with `src/api/types.ts`; `addMember` resolves `{user, added}` where `added` is `status === 201`. `export type Api = ReturnType<typeof createApi>`.
4. `token.ts`: key `board.token`; `loadToken(): string | null`, `saveToken(token)`, `clearToken()`; each wraps `localStorage` in try/catch (a throw reads as `null` and writes do nothing).
5. Run `make verify` and make it pass.

### Tests to add

- `client.test.ts` with `vi.stubGlobal("fetch", ...)`: each route's method, path and body (one table); the Bearer header present with a token and absent without; 204 -> undefined; error body -> `ApiError` fields; HTML 502 body -> `internal`/`Something went wrong`; rejected fetch -> `network`; 200 whose `json()` rejects -> `network`; `addMember` 201 vs 200.
- `token.test.ts`: round trip, clear, `null` when empty, `null` when `localStorage.getItem` throws (spy), save does not throw when `setItem` throws.
